{{Quote|This is Toluz Cheq in the Rial Kroon system. My Padawan is dead, my fleet is destroyed, and I have no means of escape. This is my final report.|Toluz Cheq|<ref name="Hero 1" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''battle''' was fought in the [[Rial Kroon system/Legends|Rial Kroon system]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Toluz Cheq]]'s [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was decimated by a new model of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] equipped with advanced [[Engine/Legends|engines]] constructed by famous [[Starship/Legends|starship]] builders from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]]. Following the battle, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] attempted to convince the Valahari to stop supplying the Confederacy with the engines but failed to do so.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The noble families of this sector have grown tired of Republic ''meddling'' in our affairs&mdash;tired of unfair taxes and regulation. We consider ourselves ''neutral'' in the war, but we will do what we must for the good of our economy.|Harko Vane|<ref name="Hero 1" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HotC date" /> the people of the neutral [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]] began [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] relations with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Valahari were prolific [[Starship/Legends|starship]] builders, and the Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|leader]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], was an old friend of [[Harko Vane]], the [[Viscount (title)/Legends|Viscount]] of the planet's royal [[House of Vane]]. Tired of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] interference in their affairs and believing that trading with the Confederacy would help their economy, the Valahari began secretly selling advanced [[Engine/Legends|engines]] for Confederate [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]]. The engines helped the Vultures achieve great speeds, exceeding that of any Republic craft at the time.<ref name="Hero 1" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Our ships are no match for their speed. We must&mdash;|Master Cheq's last words|<ref name="Hero 1" />}}
[[File:ToluzCheqHeadshot.jpg|thumb|left|120px|Toluz Cheq was killed during the battle.]]
Soon thereafter, a number of the modified Vultures attacked a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] commanded by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Toluz Cheq]] in the [[Rial Kroon system/Legends|Rial Kroon system]]. The Vultures decimated the Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] and [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]], and [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Toluz Cheq's Padawan|Cheq's Padawan]]. Cheq, who was one of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] best [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], engaged the enemy in a [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] and managed to collect some data on the new Confederate [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. However, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was unable to inflict any damage on the Vultures and could not escape from them either. Realizing that, Cheq hastily established a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] connection with the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and transmitted his data to the Jedi Order. Soon after, Cheq was killed.<ref name="Hero 1" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I have studied Master Cheq's transmission carefully. It appears these new Vulture droids are equipped with advanced engines&mdash;manufactured by the ''Valahari''.''"<br />"''The Valahari build some of the best ships in the galaxy. If they've joined the Separatists&hellip;|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Hero 1" />}}
Analyzing Cheq's transmission, the Jedi learned of the Valahari's dealings with the Confederacy. Hoping to persuade the Valahari to stop selling the engines to the Separatists, Jedi [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] went to Valahari on a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] mission. However, the Valahari refused to comply, and the Republic established a [[Blockade of Valahari|blockade]] of the world.<ref name="Hero 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
This battle appeared in [[The Clone Wars 10|''The Clone Wars'' 10]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]], illustrated by [[Brian Koschak]], and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Hero 1" /> on [[November 11]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-241/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-10----Hero-of-the-Confederacy-part-1|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars #10 &mdash; Hero of the Confederacy part 1}}</ref>
